fusions.name: Arm over Arm
fusions.desc: Strikes four times with reaching arms, each blow dealing 4 damage. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 3 seconds, and the target is [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Pigment Cloud
fusions.desc: Releases a cloud of pigment that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves the target [Blunted] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Den Mate
fusions.desc: Calls a reef octopus for 25 seconds. Every 2 seconds it grabs an enemy within 4 tiles for 6 damage.

fusions.name: Slipping the Grip
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying a condition, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
